subject: Request: Bespoke SLA offset and grace-period credit for CirraHealth
content:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@cirrahealth.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@cirrahealth.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Bespoke SLA offset and grace-period credit for CirraHealth

Jonas,

Thanks for taking this to the right place — CirraHealth experienced two incidents last month that materially impacted our production inference latency, and procurement wants a concrete remediation/offset plan before signing the renewal amendment. We appreciate Redwood's responsiveness; can you confirm what concession you can commit to so we can close procurement?

High level ask from our side: some combination of a temporary grace period on overage fees, a service-credit pool, and a short-term performance SLA credit tied to latency percentiles. We need numbers by EoW.

Best,
Elena
Director, Engineering Ops
CirraHealth

---
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@cirrahealth.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 08:20:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Bespoke SLA offset and grace-period credit for CirraHealth

Elena — appreciate the clarity. I've talked to Product and Finance; attaching a short proposal outlining a bespoke offset structure we can offer while we complete the latency mitigations. Attachment: slo-offset-proposal.pdf (2 pages)

Summary of the proposal:
- Short-term credit pool: $90,000 applied against invoices across Q1 (one-time credit spread over three invoices)
- Grace period: 60-day waiver on overage charges tied to seq-length anomalies while we deploy KV-cache tuning
- Conditional extra month: If 95th percentile end-to-end inference latency does not improve by >=25% within 60 days, we convert the credit pool to an additional free month of reserved capacity (value ~ $45k)
- Reporting: weekly latency dashboard + two-weekly joint war room calls for the next 60 days

Ask from Cirra: sign amendment draft and confirm acceptance of the conditional conversion language. We will need an executive authorization to finalize the credit numbers (Finance sign-off + Sales leadership).

Jonas
Head of Sales, EMEA & Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 09:01:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: RE: Bespoke SLA offset and grace-period credit for CirraHealth

Team — looping you in for executive approval path. Procurement is pressing for committed numbers and a signable amendment today. I have redlined the amendment (cirra-signed-amendment-draft.docx) to include the conditional conversion clause Jonas proposed.

Key ask for approval email thread: 
- Marketing/Customer Growth: not required for approval but FYI
- Sales leadership (Jonas): approve the spread and conversion mechanics
- Finance (Karthik): confirm the $90k pool and 60-day waiver are acceptable under standard concession policy and whether we should require a one-time notice/credit cap in the SOW
- Legal (Rishi): sign-off on the exact amendment wording for the conditional conversion and the waiver language.

Also, note potential precedent: Cirra is a strategic account with high expansion potential; a slightly larger concession now may prevent churn and protect ARR.

Marissa
VP, Customer Success & Enterprise Accounts
Redwood Inference

---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Approval: CirraHealth bespoke offset (CH-4721)

All — after reviewing the numbers and revenue motion, Finance approves the $90,000 credit pool and the 60-day overage waiver on the condition that:

1) We cap the total conversion value to no more than $140,000 (credit pool + converted free-month equivalency);
2) The amendment includes clear rollback language if Cirra implements a new, heavier query pattern outside the current usage profile (we propose a re-evaluation clause at day 45);
3) Procurement confirms acceptance of the weekly data sharing and that Cirra will not use the waiver to backfill previously known capacity gaps beyond the two reported incidents.

Rishi — please confirm Legal can clear the conditional conversion legal language and the rollback clause. If yes, we can finalize the amendment and sign today.

Karthik
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference

---
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Elena Park <elena.park@cirrahealth.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 11:36:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Approval: CirraHealth bespoke offset (CH-4721)

Karthik, Marissa — Legal has reviewed and can approve the amendment language with two small edits:
- Tighten the conversion trigger to reference the specific metric (95th percentile P99 latency measured on Redwood’s dashboard) and the exact measurement window (14-day rolling baseline pre-change)
- Add an explicit exception for denial-of-service-like traffic patterns caused by external third-party integrations (we'll provide a short appendix)

Elena — if those are acceptable, please confirm and I'll circulate the final doc for signatures. Jonas — once Elena confirms, Sales/Finance/Legal will sign and Ops will schedule the remediation cadence.

Rishi
Head of Legal, Redwood Inference

---
From: Elena Park <elena.park@cirrahealth.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Dec 2026 11:58:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Approval: CirraHealth bespoke offset (CH-4721)

Thanks, Rishi/Karthik/Marissa/Jonas — Cirra accepts the tightened metric language and the appendix exception; procurement will sign the amendment once we get the final doc. Tom from procurement is on this thread and will countersign.

Elena

Attachments referenced: slo-offset-proposal.pdf (proposal, 2 pages), cirra-signed-amendment-draft.docx (redline)

Action items (from thread):
- Legal to finalize amendment with Rishi edits (Rishi)
- Ops to provision KV-cache tuning plan and weekly dashboard (Jonas to coordinate with Ops)
- Finance to apply $90k credit across Q1 invoices if amendment signed (Karthik)
- Cirra to countersign amendment (Elena / Procurement)
